page.guides.android_eas.s1: In Outlook for Android choose "Add account" with an Exchange/Work account; enter your full email address, and when asked for a server use https://box.urmail.cn/api/v1/mailbox/eas with your mailbox password.

page.guides.davx5.s1: Install DAVx⁵ (from F-Droid or Google Play), tap "+" > "Log in with URL and user name". Base URL: https://box.urmail.cn/, user name: full email address, password: mailbox password.
page.guides.davx5.s2: After login DAVx⁵ discovers your CalDAV calendars and CardDAV address books. Enable the collections you want and turn on account syncing in Android settings.
page.guides.davx5.title: Android: DAVx⁵ (CalDAV/CardDAV)
page.guides.eas_caveat: Note: Exchange ActiveSync (EAS) is not yet publicly announced or commercially supported. The Outlook for Android steps below are for internal acceptance testing only and do not constitute a public commitment.
page.guides.intro: Pick your client below. All settings use your full email address and mailbox password. Do not see your app listed? Only the clients on this page are supported.
page.guides.ios.s1: Open Settings > Apps > Mail > Mail Accounts > Add Account > Other > Add Mail Account; enter your name, full email address and password.
page.guides.ios.s2: Choose IMAP. Incoming server: box.urmail.cn, port 993, SSL on. Outgoing server: box.urmail.cn, port 587 with STARTTLS (or 465 with SSL). Username is always your full email address.
page.guides.ios.s3: Optional, for contacts and calendar: Settings > Apps > Contacts > Add Account (or Calendar) > Other, then add a CardDAV account and a CalDAV account with server box.urmail.cn and your email address and password.
page.guides.ios.s4: Optional, mail + contacts + calendar in one account: add an Exchange account with server https://box.urmail.cn/api/v1/mailbox/eas, leave Domain empty, username is your full email address. EAS availability is not publicly announced yet (see the note below).
page.guides.ios.title: iOS / iPadOS (native Mail, Contacts, Calendar)
page.guides.macos.s1: Open System Settings > Internet Accounts > Add Other Account > Mail Account and enter your full email address and password; macOS picks up IMAP (993 SSL) and SMTP (587 STARTTLS / 465 SSL) automatically.
page.guides.macos.s2: For contacts and calendar, add a CardDAV account and a CalDAV account in the same Internet Accounts panel, server box.urmail.cn, with your email address and password.
page.guides.macos.title: macOS (Internet Accounts)
page.guides.thunderbird.note: Disclaimer: TbSync and the global databases approach are community projects, not part of Thunderbird itself. They work but are outside our support scope; sync problems there cannot be fixed by urMail.
page.guides.thunderbird.s1: Add a new mail account with your full email address; Thunderbird reads our autoconfig document (/mail/config-v1.1.xml) and fills in IMAP 993 SSL and SMTP 587/465 automatically. If it asks manually: IMAP box.urmail.cn 993 SSL, SMTP box.urmail.cn 587 STARTTLS.
page.guides.thunderbird.s2: Contacts and calendar: Thunderbird has no built-in CalDAV/CardDAV setup for arbitrary servers. Use the community TbSync extension with its Provider for Exchange ActiveSync / CalDAV & CardDAV, or connect via the Home Directory / global databases method.
page.guides.thunderbird.s3: Verify the account: send yourself a message and confirm it arrives on another device; then add the CardDAV address book URL https://box.urmail.cn/carddav/ if you connected contacts outside TbSync.

recall.reason.archive_source_deleted: The archive source was deleted; review again.
recall.reason.archive_source_unverified: The original archive digest is unverified; execution is blocked.
recall.reason.legal_hold: This source is held and cannot be removed.
recall.reason.legal_hold_conflict: A related archived copy in this mailbox is held.
recall.reason.local_cleanup_acknowledgem: The deletion acknowledgement is unknown; success was not assumed.
recall.reason.local_cleanup_failed: The copy remains; removal did not complete.
recall.reason.local_copy_absent: This original copy is confirmed absent.
recall.reason.local_copy_already_absent: This original copy was already absent.
recall.reason.local_message_not_found: No matching local copy was observed.
recall.reason.local_outcome_unknown: The local outcome is unknown; reconcile it again.
recall.reason.local_partial_result: Some copies are confirmed absent; inspect the remaining items.
recall.reason.local_preview_unavailable: Local inventory is unavailable; preview again later.
recall.reason.local_snapshot_absent: All selected original local copies are confirmed absent.
recall.reason.local_target_unavailable: The local mailbox, domain or tenant is unavailable.
recall.reason.recall_authority_revoked: The user’s recall authority was revoked.
recall.reason.remote_delivery_not_recall: The external inbox cannot be forcibly recalled.
recall.reason.restore_required: This intent came from a restored backup. Facts remain; a fresh preview and confirmation are required.
recall.reason.review_in_progress: A confirmed intent is in progress; reconcile that exact intent.
recall.reason.review_in_progress_by_othe: Another administrator has a confirmed intent in progress.
recall.reason.reviewed_copy_no_longer_ob: The original copy cannot be verified; its outcome remains unknown.
recall.reason.reviewed_copy_selection_in: Selected copies do not match the snapshot.
recall.reason.reviewed_copy_set_changed: Copies or authority changed; the old confirmation stopped.
recall.reason.reviewed_generation_or_cop: The mailbox generation or message identity changed.
recall.reason.reviewed_preview_expired: The confirmed snapshot expired; preview again.
recall.reason.reviewed_preview_invalid: The snapshot proof is invalid; preview again.
recall.reason.reviewed_preview_required: This historical intent requires another preview.
recall.related: Also inspect archived copies with the same Message-ID
recall.result_recorded: The result is recorded. To retry, preview again and select only copies that still require action.
recall.retry_help: Partial failures and unknown outcomes never broaden the selection. Preview again and select outstanding copies only. Later messages with the same Message-ID are never deleted by an old confirmation. Review restored intents again.
recall.scope: Remove only selected copies in mailboxes controlled by this system. Archive evidence remains. External inboxes cannot be recalled and are never marked recalled.
recall.status.delivered: Historical delivery state; not recall confirmation
recall.status.failed: Not fully completed; inspect each result
recall.title: Local message recall

registration.unavailable: Self-service registration is unavailable. Contact the platform.
registration.verification_pending: Check your email for verification. Existing accounts can sign in.
reminders.display_only: Due reminders appear here while you use your mailbox. Confirm to dismiss.
reminders.help: Up to 5 reminders, 0–40320 minutes before the event. Reminders apply to the series, including rescheduled occurrences. No email or browser notification is sent.
reminders.title: Calendar reminders
restore.quarantine_banner: This instance is quarantined after restore. Sending, fulfillment and funds transfers are paused. Operators can query existing payment and refund facts. Quarantine is not lifted automatically.
support.assign: Assign to platform support user ID
support.attachment_limit: Up to 3 attachments, totaling 500 KB. Plain text, PNG, JPEG and PDF files are provided as downloads.
support.author: Ticket author
support.diag.consent_given: You have consented to share this bundle with platform support for this ticket.
support.diag.consent_required: Sharing diagnostics with support requires your explicit consent; nothing is collected automatically.
support.diag.error_action.backup: No recent backup success was recorded. Attach a bundle so support can see the last successful backup age without accessing backup contents.
support.diag.error_action.bounce: Delivery is failing with bounce codes: check the recipient addresses, then generate a bundle that lists the exact codes support needs.
support.diag.error_action.drift: Your configuration is not fully applied yet. Wait for the applied generation to catch up; if it stays behind, attach a bundle showing the generation gap.
support.diag.intro: When something fails you can generate a diagnostic bundle that describes the problem without exposing your data, preview it, and attach it to a support ticket.
support.diag.never_included: Never included: message bodies, passwords or credentials, full email addresses, or raw application logs.
support.diag.title: Support diagnostics
support.diag.what_shared: The bundle contains only: delivery counters, bounce status codes, mailbox status counts, desired/applied configuration generations, backup recency, your client version and pseudonymized addresses. Your tenant ID is included so support can find your account.
support.diagnostics_attach: I reviewed these fields and agree to attach this exact diagnostic bundle to this ticket.
support.diagnostics_consent: I consent to collecting these counters for preview.
support.diagnostics_expires: This preview expires at {{time}}. Generate it again after expiry.
support.diagnostics_scope: Collect only this tenant’s delivery counters and mailbox status counts. Addresses, messages, credentials and raw logs are excluded. Configuration, backup and queue probes are marked not collected. Previewing does not submit a ticket.
support.empty: No tickets yet. Submit an issue using the form above.
support.help.ai.body: Remote platform and bring-your-own-key models receive the mail content you explicitly select. Only an authenticated Roundcube mailbox can authorize its own mail context; panel accounts cannot access other mailboxes. Local models do not send content to platform model providers.
support.help.ai.title: AI models and content disclosure
support.help.archive_recall.body: Archives are retained indefinitely by default. Only the tenant owner may grant time-limited content, export or retention permissions. Legal holds take precedence. Retention cleanup requires preview confirmation, followed by soft deletion and a 30-day physical-deletion delay. Local recall affects only copies controlled by this system, not externally delivered mail.
support.help.archive_recall.title: Archives, retention and local recall
support.help.dns.body: Verify domain ownership first, then configure MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC as shown on the domain page. Paid mail delivery requires verification. Recheck after DNS propagation.
support.help.dns.title: Configure domains and DNS
support.help.renewal.body: Renewals retain the remaining paid term. Monthly, quarterly and annual CNY/USD prices are separate, with no automatic conversion. Cancellation preserves service through the final paid term; renewed service requires payment.
support.help.renewal.title: Renewal and cancellation
support.help.sync.body: Confirm the operator-provided server name, IMAP on 993/TLS and SMTP on 587/STARTTLS or 465/TLS, using the full email address. Use /api/v1/carddav/ for CardDAV, /caldav/ for CalDAV and /Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync for ActiveSync. Rediscover collections; do not reuse another account’s sync cursor. Check device time, certificates and mailbox service status without disabling certificate validation. If the issue persists, submit the time, protocol, client version and error code below. Exclude credentials, message bodies and private keys. Administrators can preview aggregate diagnostics and explicitly attach them.
support.help.sync.title: Mail and collaboration synchronization
support.help.trial_refund.body: Each tenant may receive one trial after domain verification. Trials do not stack or replace paid entitlement. Refunds require platform approval of amount and entitlement timing. Coupons are not restored automatically; audited reissue is available.
support.help.trial_refund.title: Trials, coupons and refunds
support.help.unsubscribe.body: Marketing lists require explicit consent. The email link opens a confirmation page; standard one-click unsubscribe is also supported. Once unsubscribe commits, no new send attempt is authorized. Already in-flight delivery may still complete. Importing contacts does not remove unsubscribe or complaint suppressions.
support.help.unsubscribe.title: Marketing consent and unsubscribe
support.intro: Tickets contain only the support content you submit. Support access does not grant mailbox or archive access. Do not submit passwords or keys.
support.subject: Subject
transport.cache_until: Previous policy caches can safely drain after {{time}}.
transport.check_https_policy: Valid HTTPS certificate and policy body
transport.confirm: I confirm this publication and updates to this domain’s dedicated MTA-STS / TLS-RPT records. Resolve duplicate or invalid records first. Other DNS records are preserved. For external DNS, review and confirm the record plan.
transport.dns_help: Required records: managed authoritative zones converge through configuration. External DNS requires a reviewed record plan. Publication is not publicly effective before the records are applied.
transport.domain_required: Verify and activate the domain before configuring transport security.
transport.observation_failed: Verification failed; check the items below
transport.reports_empty: No reports yet. Reports appear only when external senders support and submit them.
transport.reports_unverified: Shows up to 100 redacted summaries. HTTPS submission does not prove reporter identity. Unverified reports never authorize actions, charge accounts, or enable enforcement.
transport.scope: Publish a domain MTA-STS policy and receive TLS reports. Test and verify before enforcement. DANE is currently disabled.
transport.title: Mail transport security
transport.transition_help: Start with testing. Enforcement requires one previous cache period of observation and successful DNS, HTTPS policy and SMTP TLS checks within one hour. Publish none and drain all previous caches before changing the receiving host or disabling publication. A shorter new lifetime does not erase older caches.
